mode: Window-free egui and lint checks only; no desktop/native-window, file-dialog or rendered-preview launches.
scope: Classic v11 moves quick actions to a second row when available chrome width is below 600 egui points. File/Edit/View and adjacent Interface/Settings controls stay on the first row. Both rows remain visible when the ribbon automatically hides and participate in hover reveal. Wide and historical-skin layouts retain the existing code path.
checks: New repeated-layout checks cover 1360x900 scale 1 light, 700x500 scale 2 dark, 480x500 scale 1 light and 360x500 scale 2 dark. Every top action is on screen with pairwise nonoverlapping bounds. File/Edit/View spacing remains at least 12 points and Interface stays beside Settings. Settings and skin chooser open/cancel through actual pointer events. Narrow quick-action positions survive ribbon hide/reveal. Document/history remain unchanged.
regression: Before the layout fix, the added geometry probe found Clear Canvas overlapping Interface at 480 points and Clear Canvas extending beyond the 360-point window. The current full-suite log validates the corrected layout.
limits: The second row is a responsive PaintCraft presentation choice, not qualified native-reference behavior. Native/rendered visual parity remains unverified. No action semantics or document operations changed.
